name: Naga, Cannibale
body:
NAGA, CANNIBALE
CR 12

XP 19,200
CE Huge aberration (psionic, shapechanger)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 26 touch 11, flat-footed 23 (+3 Dex, +15 natural, –2 size)
hp 168 (16d8+96)
Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +14

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +19 (6d6+13 plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks devour being, fast swallow, psionic fist +2, swallow whole (3d6 bludgeoning and 3d6 acid plus 1d4 Cha drain, AC 17, 16 hp)
Egoist Powers Known (ML 10th; power points; 113; DC 15 + power level; concentration +15)

Talents-create sound, detect psionics, missive
1st-corrosive aura, demoralize, mind thrust, natural healing, vigor
2nd-biofeedback, chameleon, control sound, id insinuation
3rd-dispel psionics, hustle, physical acceleration, psionic blast
4th-aura sight, fold space, hidden body, slip the bonds
5th-adapt body, pierce the veils, psychic crush, psychofeedback

STATISTICS

Str 28, Dex 17, Con 22, Int 20, Wis 19, Cha 20
Base Atk +12; CMB +21 (+25 grapple); CMD 34 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Extend Power, Greater Psionic Fist, Improved Initiative, Overchannel, Power Attack, Psionic Meditation, Psionic Fist, Quicken Power Skills Acrobatics +22, Autohypnosis +23, Intimidate +24, Knowledge (arcana) +24, Knowledge (history) +24, Perception +23, Sense Motive +23, Spellcraft +24, Survival +23
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic
SQ change shape (major metamorphosis, ML 11th, see devour being)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Devour Being (Ex)

When a cannibale naga eats a dead creature or a creature dies or is reduced to 0 Charisma while swallowed by a cannibale naga, that creature cannot be resurrected by an ability short of a miracle or wish effect. A cannibale naga can use their change shape ability to assume the form of any creature that it has devoured in this way (to the parameters of their change shape ability).

Psionic Powers

A cannibale naga manifests powers as a 10th-level egoist.

Spacious Maw (Ex)

A cannibale naga can swallow creatures of up to Gargantuan size with its swallow whole ability.

ABOUT

Unsatisfied with the gradual amassing of power and knowledge over countless lifetimes, cannibale naga accelerate their growth through the ravenous consumption of rivals it deems worthy. Their pliable bodies and immense psychometabolic powers serve as potent tools in this frantic escalation, with both assuming whatever traits are necessary to swallow the next prize.
